title: Rice农业娇宠：从种子到丰收的全貌 春种秋收

tasks.task_text: Describe rice planting and its cultivation process.

subtasks.task_text: Describe rice planting and its cultivation process.
subtasks.text: Observe the selection of rice seeds that are carefully chosen for their resilience and suitability to local conditions.

subtasks.task_text: Describe rice planting and its cultivation process.
subtasks.text: Note the process of planting rice seeds by hand in a prepared patty, emphasizing the labor involved.

subtasks.task_text: Describe rice planting and its cultivation process.
subtasks.text: Notice the flooded field (patty) created for rice cultivation and the importance of a well-prepared environment for the rice to grow.
Mention the importance of leveling the field to ensure even water distribution.
Look at the use of organic matter, such as compost or manure, to enrich the soil and enhance its fertility.

tasks.task_text: Describe the importance of water management in rice cultivation.

subtasks.text: Observe how water helps suppress weeds, giving the rice plants a competitive advantage.
Note that root vegetables like carrots and potatoes are ready for harvest when their foliage dies back.
Highlight the use of hand harvesting for leafy greens like lettuce and herbs.
